import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

**Build `--listen`, with a few sharp adjustments.** The goal — every paper or article you hear as an AI audio edition also lands in the Highlights/ref-note loop — is right, and most of the plumbing already exists. The naive version (hard-wire `sase-listen`, have `create` write the Obsidian note, re-typeset a paper through pandoc) is the wrong implementation.

Report: `sase/repos/research/202610/highlights_create_listen/highlights_create_listen__grk.md`  
Snapshot: `file:explicit:7b58184ee80d75a374cd4caf` (`research:202610/highlights_create_listen/highlights_create_listen__grk.md`)

### Recommended solution

`bob highlights create <target> --listen` (`-L`) is an opt-in *generation* step on intake. `create` already *discovers* companion audio; this flag *makes* it.

- **Targets:** existing `.md` (pandoc as today), local `.pdf`, PDF URLs, arXiv `/abs|html|pdf/<id>`. HTML articles stay on `clip`. Same `--listen` flag on `clip` too — the goal names articles as well as papers.
- **PDF sources:** stamp the original bytes. Never re-typeset a paper.
- **Renderer:** chezmoi `highlights.listen_command: sase-listen render {target} -e full -o {output}`. Bob has no default binary name. No `sh -c`. Inherit stdout/stderr so the live checklist shows in full. Do not pass `--json`.
- **Ref notes:** `create` still writes `xlib/` (PDF + MP3). Mac `scan` still writes `ref/` with the player embed. `bob_xlib_pull` already rsyncs MP3s.
- **Feed:** leave publication to sase-listen (`feed.auto_publish: true` is already set).

### Adjustments called out in the report

The request said “transcriptions”; sase-listen is TTS *narration*. “Create the ref note” is still scan’s job (same boundary as `clip`). `{output}` is the integration contract so bob does not parse library manifests. Dry-run prints the argv and does not spawn — sase-listen `--dry-run` still bills the writer.
